tech_stack.persistence: Spring Data R2DBC + Flyway (embedded H2 for boot/test only)
tech_stack.version_note: Description names no version; tech-stack default Java 21 LTS applies. Boot major 3 pinned.

build_order: shared config (externalized values: reorder window 60s, metric boundaries, buffer capacities, timeouts, logging/export)
domain (Telemetry Sample, Sensor Metric Boundary, Event Revision, events)
application ports + use cases (Intake, Validation, Backfill Reordering, Event Log append/broadcast)
infrastructure adapters (R2DBC append-only repository, audit adapter, broadcast sink)
api (device ingestion endpoint, correlation WebFilter, ProblemDetail mapping)
wiring (stream pipeline subscriptions with lifecycle-managed disposal, bean factories)

module_layout.integration: Single in-process reactive pipeline Intake -> Validation -> Reordering -> Event Log via Flux streams with bounded Sinks (onBackpressureBuffer(capacity,false), declared overflow posture, counted drops). Contexts talk only through published events/ports. Event Log broadcasts to downstream analytics through a backpressure-aware, versioned, append-only event stream port; the external consumer is out of process and that boundary is declared here. Composition root @SpringBootApplication lives in the base package. One registration mechanism: wiring factory beans. Delivery posture: at-most-once inbound (no dedup identity); retries from devices may produce duplicate Event Revisions and consumers must be idempotent. Late samples beyond the 60s window are appended as Event Revisions (assumption, flagged).

drivers: Flyway migration runner over a distinct JDBC url
persistence.storage_paradigm: Relational append-only event log (time-series records keyed by device, metric, t_device) plus append-only audit table
persistence.data_model: telemetry_record (device, metric, t_device, t_ingress, value, validation_status, revision, version) with strictly append-only inserts; corrections and backfills insert new revisions, never update/delete. audit_trail (actor, action, outcome, timestamp, correlation_id) append-only.
persistence.queries: Append; read latest revision per (device, metric, t_device); range read by t_device window for downstream replay. Indexed by (device, metric, t_device, revision).
persistence.migration_plan: Expand-only Flyway scripts under classpath db/migration, PostgreSQL-compatible portable types; no ddl-auto; embedded H2 only via test profile.
persistence.backup_recovery: Append-only history enables replay; operator-level database backup and point-in-time recovery; no in-app deletion.
open_questions: Dedup identity for at-least-once retries vs corrections (currently at-most-once declared)
Ranges for ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke: validation disabled/unbounded pending operator answer; swim pace has only lower bound >45 sec/100m
Handling of samples older than the 60s window

observability.correlation_key: requestId generated or adopted by an interface-layer WebFilter, carried in Reactor Context via contextWrite and passed explicitly as a field of every audit record; correlation lives in the Reactor Context and as an explicit field of every audit record; correlation id on log lines is not promised (no MDC propagation mechanism is installed).

audit_trail.sink: append-only audit_trail table written through an infrastructure R2DBC adapter; best-effort within the reactive chain

observability.metric_tag_rule: Bounded tags only (status, kind, stage, outcome); never deviceId or other entity ids.
observability.uncounted_failures: none: every drop/overflow/failure outcome increments telemetry.pipeline.dropped or the outcome/status tagged counters

export.logs: Structured ECS JSON lines written to a local rolling file sink (logs/telemetry-ingestion-processing.log, logging.structured.format.file=ecs, size/history rolling set in config unit); shipped by the platform (Filebeat/Elastic Agent) to Elasticsearch-class tools; no direct-to-cluster appender and no runtime dependency on it.
export.metrics: Micrometer via actuator; Prometheus-style scrape endpoint only if named later (none now); no push.
export.boot_gate: Boot test passes with the external log/metrics tools absent.

risks: Delivery posture/dedup identity unresolved; duplicates from retries may mint false revisions
Sample ranges for ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke undefined; validation disabled for them
Behavior beyond the 60s reorder window unspecified
Broadcast placement in Event Log is a low-confidence assumption
Sink overflow under 1Hz burst loads: capacities and overflow posture must be config-driven and drops counted
Reactive MDC loss across event-loop hops unless context propagation is installed
Event-loop blocking from JDBC Flyway runner must stay confined to startup
